props.title: Aether Resilience Hub
props.description: A warm, privacy-first operating system for student support: fast enough for the moment of need, careful enough for safety, and structured enough for campus teams to improve services.

props.title: Live care map
props.description: Stabilize, navigate, belong, and practice lanes provide clear next-step pathways for students.

items.title: Stabilize
items.description: When a student needs immediate grounding, safety planning, or crisis support.

items.title: Navigate
items.description: When the hard part is finding the right next door: peer, campus, self-guided, or professional.

items.title: Belong
items.description: When isolation is the risk signal and a moderated peer pathway can restore connection.

items.title: Practice
items.description: When resilience needs repetition through tiny actions that fit a real student week.

props.title: From first signal to sustained recovery
props.body: The pathway is intentionally modular: each step can stand alone, but together they create a humane progression from noticing strain to building daily resilience.

items.title: Early Signal Detection
items.description: Weekly check-in identifies stress, connection, sleep, and safety trends early.

items.title: Immediate Stabilization
items.description: Students can create a practical safety plan and activate crisis support in one click.

items.title: Right-Sized Support
items.description: Resource navigator routes students to peer, self-guided, campus, or urgent options.

items.title: Social Reinforcement
items.description: Peer circles reduce isolation and create identity-safe belonging pathways.

items.title: Sustainable Growth
items.description: Habit planning builds long-term resilience through short, repeatable daily actions.

props.title: What world-class wellbeing products get right

items.title: One-tap access
items.description: The first useful action should be available before login, intake, or explanation.

items.title: Safeguarded peer belonging
items.description: Peer support is strongest when belonging, moderation, and escalation pathways are designed together.

items.title: Structured self-guided care
items.description: Students need short pathways that turn stress, sleep, and focus signals into doable routines.

items.title: Privacy-forward signal use
items.description: Aggregate trends can help teams improve services without exposing private student reflections.

props.title: Resilience toolkit modules
props.description: Check-in, safety planning, navigation, peer matching, and habit planning are editable and runnable here.
